seoTitle: Image Border and Frame Adder (Solid, Rounded, Polaroid)
metaDescription: Add a solid border, rounded corners or a polaroid-style frame with a thick bottom edge to a picture and download the framed image.
intro: Add a solid, rounded or polaroid frame to a picture.
why:
Pick a style, set the border width and colour, and download the result. Solid adds an even border. Rounded clips the picture to rounded corners with a coloured ring. Polaroid adds a thicker bottom edge like an instant photo.

Transparent corners need PNG. If you save as JPEG the outside area is filled white or with the colour you set.
howTo: Set width, colour and corner radius.

faq.q: Can I make the corners transparent?
faq.a: Yes, keep the outside colour as transparent and save as PNG.
